coordinateConvention: row and col are zero-based; 7 rows and 4 columns.

rules.notes: A talent requires row*5 points in the same tree. Prerequisite talent rank must meet qty. Level20 has at most11 total points. All trees included so higher tiers can display locked.

crossCheck.note: Compared only base talent definitions; ignored SoD runes and abilities. Current source includes SoD data outside this subset.
